title: Monthly giving is chosen for me before I pick anything
what_happened: On the Donate page, "Monthly" is already chosen in a bright red button and every amount reads "/mo". "One-Time" sits beside it as plain dark text that doesn't look much like a button. If I hadn't been looking for it, I could have signed up to give every month without meaning to.
expected: Nothing chosen until I choose, or One-Time first, and both choices should look like buttons of the same size.

title: Two boxes ticked for me: extra fee money and a news sign-up
what_happened: Under the amounts, "Cover transaction fees… Add $1.44" was already ticked, so my $50 gift is quietly more than $50. "Keep me updated on … Comunidad Connect news" was also already ticked, which signs me up for mail I didn't ask for. The "$1.44" line is small grey text.
expected: Both boxes empty until I tick them myself. The amount I pick should be the amount I pay unless I choose to add more.
